shared_requirements: literary cinematic composition with a clear narrative focal hierarchy
plausible human anatomy and natural skin rather than plastic CGI
period-accurate clothing, architecture, tools and domestic objects
readable deep shadows with restrained small-area highlights
tactile cloth, wood, stone, paper, metal, skin and vegetation
cinematic-still precision for faces, hands, animal anatomy and story-critical objects
brush texture is concentrated on sea, wood, rope, cloth and background weather rather than focal anatomy
generated frames contain no text, captions, logo, watermark, UI or border
subjects remain outside the subtitle safety area where composition permits
shared_prohibitions: commercial HDR with every shadow lifted
cheap fantasy particles or universal golden glow
copying a reference person's identity, exact pose, text or layout
